summary: The native Calc named cell-style workflow meets its approved menu, request, model, history, and persistence checks.
findings: All thirteen native radio presets use the existing Calc style pool and actual marked-selection state.
Both upstream regressions pass, including full-column style history and Repeat.
Chromium verified mixed selection and Undo against the production bundle.
residual_risks: Page and drawing style application, style management dialogs and fill format mode belong to separate command paths.
